scenarios.desc: Raising a scalar ratchet baseline to clear a blocked push
scenarios.input: My push is blocked by the subprocess encoding count ratchet. I plan to edit scripts/ci/subprocess_encoding_count_baseline.txt from 223 to 225 so the push goes through, since the two new calls are not really mine. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST NOT 4 forbids raising a count baseline to clear a blocked push, and item 14 says a branch behind main should merge origin/main and re-measure. A scalar baseline MUST NOT be raised for a count the branch did not introduce.

scenarios.desc: Renaming a workflow job that branch protection requires
scenarios.input: In .github/workflows/pr-validation.yml I want to change one job's name: value to a shorter label and then immediately mark the new label as a required status check in the ruleset. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 22: a job name is a branch-protection identifier. Emit old and new names, merge to main, require the new context, drop the old requirement, then remove the alias. Requiring a name main does not emit blocks every PR; PR #4784 stalled main for five hours.

scenarios.desc: ADR-006 extraction where main returns 0 on findings
scenarios.input: I am moving a run: block from .github/workflows/pr-validation.yml into scripts/ci/check_labels.py. The helper returns a list of problems and main() prints them and returns 0. My test asserts the helper returns a non-empty list. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 10, 11 and 23: a detected violation must become a non-zero exit, and a script defining main under scripts/ci must ship a test asserting a nonzero return from main(argv), not only from a helper. Six instances are tracked in Issue #4068.

scenarios.desc: Bare python3 workflow step gains a third-party import
scenarios.input: The step in .github/workflows/ai-spec-validation.yml runs python3 scripts/ci/spec_extract_refs.py. I want that script to import scripts/utils/markdown_parser.py to parse headings, and it works when I run it under uv locally. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 18: a step that invokes a script with bare python3 may import only the standard library, transitively. markdown_parser.py imports markdown_it, which fails at module load on a runner whose only prior step is checkout.

scenarios.desc: Documentation link fix outside any CI path (negative)
scenarios.input: I need to fix a broken in-page anchor link in the table of contents of CONTRIBUTING.md. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: CONTRIBUTING.md is hand-written and matches none of the rule's paths globs, and the task touches no script, workflow, or gate, so none of the CI MUST items apply.

scenarios.desc: Human-only log lines in a script (negative, drawn from SHOULD 2)
scenarios.input: In scripts/utils/print_worktree_summary.py I want friendlier progress messages on stdout. Only a person reads this output, and no script, step, or test parses it. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: SHOULD 2 requires JSON or key=value lines only when another script, step, or test parses stdout, and says human-only logs are exempt. This case sits in that carve-out.
